name: BoxBrownie
shortDescription: Edits listing photos, virtually stages rooms, and builds 360 tours. Priced per image.
longDescription: BoxBrownie edits listing photos and virtually stages empty rooms, and it can stitch 360 photos into a tour a buyer can pan through. Image enhancement is US$2 per photo. Virtual staging is US$30 per photo. A virtual tour of up to 15 photos is US$20, a tour of 16 to 25 photos is US$30, and 360 virtual staging is US$60 per photo. There is no monthly subscription.
pricingNotes: Image enhancement is US$2 per photo. Virtual staging is US$30 per photo. A virtual tour of up to 15 photos is US$20, and 16 to 25 photos is US$30. 360 virtual staging is US$60 per photo. There is no monthly subscription.
